cite.quote: Installers mount units where the ceiling tile is convenient. Mounted near the door, a unit counts the corridor; under a vent, it sees air flow as people.
Take the floor plan with ceiling height, doors, windows, vents and seats.
For each candidate mount point, compute the sensor footprint at seated head height, 1.2 m above the floor, from the 90 degree field of view.
Score each layout on seat coverage, overlap between units, and exposure to heat sources and doorways.
After install, walk one person to marked spots and check each unit sees them where the plan predicts.
